description: Premium Heyflow-style landing page with multi-step questionnaire for reverse-Tinder dating matching funnel. 8 screens, photo upload, dark premium design, mobile-first.

userStories.title: Project scaffold + Welcome Screen

userStories.title: Multi-step form engine + transitions
userStories.description: JS form engine: one-question-per-screen, smooth CSS slide transitions, forward/back nav, progress bar updates, answers stored in JS state. 8 total steps.

userStories.title: Choice cards + freetext screens

userStories.title: Slider + intent screens
userStories.description: Screen 5: adventure vs planned visual choice. Screen 6: 3 choice cards for relationship intent.

userStories.title: Photo upload screen
userStories.description: Drag-drop + click upload, client-side preview, 5MB max, mobile camera picker, remove option. Premium styled upload area.
